Title: Data Factory supports data movement in Australia regions

Body.Content: Azure Data Factory supports the Australia East and Australia Southeast regions for data movement. If your destination data store is in Azure Australia, you can use Data Factory for your cloud and hybrid data-movement needs. You can learn more about our globally available data-movement service and how it works in the Data movement activities article.
